cohort: 155 children conceived following PGT and 303 children conceived after IVF without PGT
finding: No significant differences were found between children conceived with and without PGT in terms of health, well-being, and development at school age (5-8 years), although both groups had more positive outcomes compared to population data.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was more frequent in PGT singleton pregnancies compared to IVF-only singleton pregnancies.
